name: Mercado Pago MCP
description: Read-only-by-default MCP server for Mercado Pago. Read tools (payments, merchant orders, preferences, payment methods, and local HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification) inherit Guard's handling; create_preference (--allow-writes) and refund_payment (--allow-refunds) stay on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Run with no flags (default) for strict read-only inspection and offline HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification; create_preference and refund_payment remain unregistered.

Pass --allow-writes (or MP_ALLOW_WRITES=true) to enable create_preference for Checkout Pro links while keeping refund_payment disabled unless --allow-refunds (or MP_ALLOW_REFUNDS=true) is explicitly set.
Always pass an explicit idempotency_key on write or refund calls and use a Mercado Pago test token during development.
